name: Lord of Change

bonuses.name: Foresee the Ending
bonuses.text: The GM gains 2 Ruin at the start of each of this Threat's turns.

bonuses.name: Entrusted by Tzeentch
bonuses.text: This Threat may use Ruin Actions and has 5 personal Ruin.

bonuses.name: One with the Warp
bonuses.text: This threat never encounters Perils of the Warp when using Psychic Powers.

abilities.name: Everchanging Presence
abilities.text: Anyone who sees a Lord of Change must make a DN 5 Terror Test.

abilities.name: Maleficarum
abilities.text: The Lord of Change attempts to activate any two psychic powers including Smite or a Maleficarum psychic power, treat Corruption as 7.

abilities.name: Pluck from the Warp
abilities.text: Spend 1 Ruin, the Lord of Change cuts a portal to the Immaterium and a mob of 7 Pink Horrors emerges. They may act immediately.

abilities.name: Healing Flames
abilities.text: Spend 2 Ruin, the Lord of Change recovers 3 Wounds.

abilities.name: Bolt of Change
abilities.text: Spend 2 Ruin, the Lord of Change unleashes a bolt of energy at a target who must make a successful DN 4 Willpower Test or transform into a Chaos Spawn.

abilities.name: Psychic Entity
abilities.text: Any time another psyker attempts to manipulate the warp, the Lord of Change attempts to Deny the Witch.

determination: Spend 1 Ruin to roll 7d6. Daemons can roll Determination against Mortal Wounds. Any Wounds negated by Determination are ignored instead of being converted to Shock.
note: Keyword PSKYER printed as such (likely PSYKER). Determination line has no 'Daemonic Determination' name.
